Game Overview

Jungle Cafe puts players into a restaurant experience centered on manage a bustling jungle cafe with your fellow monkey as you race against the clock. Master click-and-drag mechanics to serve fruity orders swiftly, earn cash to unlock new fruits, and upgrade your cafe. Delight in vibrant jungle scenes while enhancing your strategic prowess and keeping monkey customers happy.

How to Play

Getting started in Jungle Cafe doesn't take long to learn. Manage a bustling jungle cafe with your fellow monkey as you race against the clock. Master click-and-drag mechanics to serve fruity orders swiftly, earn cash to unlock new fruits, and upgrade your cafe. Delight in vibrant jungle scenes while enhancing your strategic prowess and keeping monkey customers happy.
